notes: PAP reference G33/2229. Whole four-room apartment offered through PAP in Orléans, on the first floor of a maintained ten-storey residence with lifts and a caretaker. The complete live detail page describes an 87 m2 home with an entrance and fitted storage, oak-parquet living and dining area, recently fitted open kitchen, 10 m2 balcony, two bedrooms including one with an en-suite bathroom, a second shower room, separate WC, an approximately 5 m2 cellar and a private 12 m2 underground parking space. It exposes collective gas heating with individual radiator allocators, monthly coproperty charges of approximately EUR 430 including water, heating and caretaker services, and taxe fonciere of EUR 1,983. The stated EUR 235,000 is the full apartment price. The source contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale, delayed-vacancy, managed-residence or special ownership wording. PAP exposed 17 property photos, a virtual tour and a publication date of 13 May 2026. No energy class or other unexposed fact is inferred.
